title: remaining gaps in FR_REGIONS
authoritative_artifact: the .md. Where this sidecar and the .md differ, the .md supersedes.
verdict_statement: No change to FR_REGIONS is warranted for this dataset. The premise that s2/s3 use department names FR_REGIONS does not handle is REFUTED: the three cited examples (gironde, nord, atlantique) are all already keys. A maximal gazetteer recovers at most 8400 French test rows (0.496%), an optimistic union bound. Adding keys DELETES tokens from live IDF-weighted features, a net-negative trade.
headline_number_meaning: max French test rows a maximal disjoint department gazetteer could add, as an optimistic upper bound, out of 1694445 total France test rows = 0.496%
new_defect_summary: Not a FR_REGIONS defect. France has ZERO training rows: country_rows in train_s1/s2/s3.json contains only US and India, and crossfit.py:112 iterates for c in ('US','India'), so the ranker is fit without France and applied to 1694445 French test rows. The codebase already acknowledges this at decoy_postfilter.py:17-18.

method.matching_rule: normalize.py:322-335 - a France row resolves a state iff some whole comma-component, after translit_text + strip_accents + lowercase + punctuation-to-space, equals one of the 14 FR_REGIONS keys
method.bound_type: union bound over per-key minimum token counts from addr_tokens['France']

top4000_cutoffs.note: build_profile.py:140 keeps most_common(4000). A token absent from the list has count <= cutoff, NOT 0. Substitution used everywhere.

method.accent_correction: TOKEN_RE [a-z0-9]+ (build_profile.py:28) runs without strip_accents, so accented ile-de-france yields profile token 'le'. Substituted max(count(ile), count(le)). Measured ile/le: 303/1992 s1, 817/4882 s2, 794/5050 s3.

premise_refutation.claim_tested: test_s2 and test_s3 encode geography with DEPARTMENT names, and most of those departments are absent from FR_REGIONS
premise_refutation.reason: The s1->s2 count rise is a FREQUENCY shift, not a COVERAGE gap. All three cited examples are already FR_REGIONS keys.
premise_refutation.note: The COUNTS quoted in the work order are all correct; only the interpretation is wrong.

current_dictionary_bound.s1_vacuous_reason: UB 261751 exceeds rows 259452, so the bound cannot detect anything in s1. This is why it cannot support a 100% claim.

gazetteer_extension.threshold: candidate kept if its binding-token count exceeds the rank-4000 cutoff (>60) in at least one file
gazetteer_extension.disjointness_rule: candidate key's token set must be disjoint from the 20-token set the current 14 keys already use
gazetteer_extension.why_optimistic: union bound: keys whose components co-occur in one row are double-counted, and a token count is not a component count. True recoverable figure is LOWER.

idf_argument.conclusion: Adding a key DELETES a live feature rather than adding one.
idf_argument.mechanism: normalize.py:335 `continue` means a matching component's tokens are never appended to `toks` (line 342 toks.extend is skipped), so they never reach atoks (prep.py:16), so they never reach features.py:129 wa (IDF-weighted address overlap), features.py:123-124 a_jac/a_cont, or keys.py:39 alph blocking tokens.
idf_argument.worked_example: marne occurs 1061 times in French s3 rows and is NOT a key, so it stays in atoks and contributes to wa_wj when an s2/s3 record and its s1 counterpart share it. Adding 'marne':'idf' would delete it from all 1061 rows.
idf_argument.trade: lose ~0.55% of address IDF mass to gain 0.496% more state coverage = net negative
idf_argument.liveness_of_affected_features: wa_* is consumed at features.py:139-146 into w_sum, w_sum_rank, w_sum_gap, which feed the ranker
idf_argument.inference_note: Mechanism argument from quoted code plus measured token mass. NOT a measured F0.5 delta. Full pipeline not run.

france_has_no_training_data.evidence_1_profile: country_rows in train_s1.json = {US:1323633, India:883188}; train_s2.json = {India:2017799, US:3016817}; train_s3.json = {US:3170056, India:2115547}. No France key. by_country likewise. Raw Select-String for "France" against train_s1.json returns 0 matches.
france_has_no_training_data.evidence_2_code: _upstream/src/crossfit.py:112 `for c in ("US", "India"):` and line 122 concat over the same tuple. France never enters stage-2 context or the training table.
france_has_no_training_data.evidence_3_codebase_acknowledges: _upstream/src/decoy_postfilter.py:17-18 '(b) the country has no training labels (e.g. France in the test set)... Without labels for that country the model is least calibrated.' and line 179 derives `unlabeled` at run time.
france_has_no_training_data.consequence: INFERENCE: the LightGBM ranker (crossfit.py:143) is fit on US and India pairs only, then applied to 1694445 French test rows. Every France-specific parameter, including whatever state_eq (features.py:114) contributes, is extrapolated and never validated on French labels.
france_has_no_training_data.relevance: The binding constraint on France is the absence of training labels, not the absence of dictionary entries. This is the strongest argument for leaving FR_REGIONS alone.
france_has_no_training_data.why_no_change: French training labels cannot be fabricated (no ground truth exists) and decoy_postfilter already handles the unlabelled case. Reported as context only.

dead_weight_entries.evidence: not in the top 4000 of ANY of the six profile files
dead_weight_entries.phrasing_rule: NOT 'does not occur'. Counts are <= the rank-4000 cutoff; the tail is truncated.
dead_weight_entries.recommendation: No case for removal either: they are correct geography, cost nothing, and removing them changes nothing measurable.

unhandled_but_should_be.reasoning: 58 of 84 departments do not clear the top-4000 cutoff in any file; the ~20 that do are worth <=8400 rows while costing ~0.55% of address IDF mass. The genuinely missing tokens (de, la, du, des, le, les) belong to ADDR_CANON_FR not FR_REGIONS and are already established as settled; not re-measured.

cross_country_collisions.reason: STATE_MAPS is country-keyed (normalize.py:250), so a French row can never read US_STATES or IN_STATES. No cross-country collision is possible in the state path by construction.
cross_country_collisions.within_france: The 14 keys map to 4 canonical values with no ambiguous key; each key appears once.
cross_country_collisions.theoretical_collision_tested: nord (a department) vs the word 'north' in a street name. A whole-component match is required, so 'rue du nord' does NOT match key 'nord'. The continue-consumes-component rule protects this.

self_map_defect_separate.independent_confirmation: fleet log _fr2.log: '[FAIL] France abbreviations are ALSO self-mapped'
self_map_defect_separate.scope_statement: This is a statement about the SELF-MAP LOOP ONLY. It is NOT evidence that the gazetteer residual is harmless.
self_map_defect_separate.recommendation: Optional and cosmetic on this dataset. Safe future-proofing, not a scoring fix.

contradiction_71_vs_97.my_position: Three distinct quantities, not two competing estimates.

same criterion as D073, independently reproduced

contradiction_71_vs_97.set_relationship: D077's 43411 unparseable France rows (2.5620%) are a SUBSET of my 489470, not a competing estimate
contradiction_71_vs_97.difference_meaning: 489470 - 43411 = 446059 French rows that are well-formed and comma-bearing yet carry no component equal to any of the 14 keys

Explicitly do NOT add department names
recommended_actions.expected_value: mechanism in normalize.py:335 shows it removes signal

limitations: addr_tokens / name_tokens are TOP 4000 ONLY (build_profile.py:140). Every 'not in the top 4000' means count <= rank-4000 cutoff (23/58/60), NEVER 'does not occur'.
The profile destroys component structure, so all section 3 figures are UPPER BOUNDS, not direct counts.
The IDF trade-off is a mechanism argument from quoted code plus measured token mass, NOT a measured F0.5 delta. Full pipeline not run.
No raw *.tsv was opened. All data came from the six profile JSONs.
Did not re-derive the postcode, region-coverage, function-word, or self-map findings marked settled in FLEET_BRIEF.md / D073 / D128.
